_comment: Seven products whose Gemma no-persona demand curves span the study's behavioral archetypes: flat always-buy (Coca-Cola, Heinz), flippers at 100%/160% of regular price (Bounty, Lay's), erratic (Gillette), noisy (Capri Sun), and a stepper at 120% (Doritos). Regular prices are the ones that run used, not scraped.
